title: Inter vs Stuttgart: Çalhanoğlu Strain Confirmed, Sučić In per Sky | Nerazzurri Daily
description:
Inter can cover Çalhanoğlu with Sučić — Inter.it confirms his thigh strain before Stuttgart tonight.
Free daily digest in English: https://www.nerazzurridaily.com/go/yt/?ed=85

Blue means the club said it. Pink means only the papers did.

CONFIRMED — Çalhanoğlu has a strain in the flexor muscles at the back of his right thigh after tests on Tuesday; Inter gave no recovery time (Inter.it, Nov 24).
CONFIRMED — Chivu says Zieliński won’t be available; Stones “is doing better and will be in the squad” (Inter.it, Nov 24).
CONFIRMED — Inter have six points, one behind Stuttgart, before tonight’s game at San Siro (Inter.it, Nov 24–25).
REPORTED — Sučić takes Çalhanoğlu’s place in midfield; Esposito and Thuram up front, Thuram favored over Lautaro (Sky Sport Italia, Nov 24).
REPORTED — Tuttosport has a similar lineup but starts Mkhitaryan, and lists Bonny as unavailable (Tuttosport, Nov 25).
NEXT — Inter vs VfB Stuttgart, Wed, Nov 25, 3:00 PM ET, 21:00 CET, Champions League matchday 5. US TV: Paramount+.
